title: Chiefs nose tackle Khyiris Tonga is playing almost as much offense as Travis Hunter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chiefs nose tackle Khyiris Tonga is playing almost as much offense as Travis Hunter
sources.description: Jaguars cornerback/wide receiver Travis Hunter has been much-hyped for his status as a two-way player, first as a Heisman Trophy winner at Colorado and now in the NFL.
